::: {.hero}
[A(I)rbeitskreis]{.hero-name}

[How a group of academics actually uses AI in teaching and research.]{.hero-tagline}

[Browse the projects](projects/index.qmd){.hero-cta}[Add your own](contribute.qmd){.hero-secondary}
:::

We are a group of academics who meet to talk about how AI is changing the way we teach and
do research. Not the discourse about it, the actual practice: what we tried, what broke,
what we now use every week.

This site collects those workflows. Every entry is something a member of the group
genuinely uses, written up concretely enough that a colleague could copy it.

::: {.section-label}
The name
:::

*Arbeitskreis* is German for a working group. Slip an I into it and you get
*A(I)rbeitskreis*, which is either a good pun or a warning about what happens when
academics name things.
